## Highlights

- Bundles `horus-gateway` 0.7.2 and `horus` 0.7.2.
- Supports the short reasoning-summary headings emitted by opted-in HTTP Responses routes.

## Install or upgrade

```sh
horus-gateway exit
cargo install --force --locked horus-cli --version 0.7.2
horus-gateway serve --background
```

- Gateway protocol 23 and configuration version 14 are unchanged.
